title: Motion for an extension of time within which to file the briefs on the merits

pages.text:
1600 Wilson Boulevard, Suite 700
Arlington, VA 22209
703.243.9423

Scott S. Harris
Clerk of the Court
Supreme Court of the United States
One First Street NE
Washington, DC 20543

RE: Winston Tyler Hencely v. Fluor Corporation et al., No. 24-924

Dear Mr. Harris:

 On June 2, 2025, the Court granted the above petition. Under the Court’s rules, Petitioner’s
opening brief on the merits is currently due on July 17, 2025.

 The parties jointly request an extension of time to file Petitioner’s brief on the merits and the
joint appendix and an extension of time to file Respondents’ brief on the merits. Pursuant to Rule
30.4 and subject to the Court’s approval, the parties propose the following briefing schedule:

 Petitioner’s Brief on the Merits and Joint Appendix:  July 31, 2025
 Respondents’ Brief on the Merits:    September 15, 2025

 This schedule would allow the Court to hear this case during the October sitting.

Dated: June 6, 2025



Respectfully submitted,

/s/ Tyler R. Green
Tyler R. Green
CONSOVOY MCCARTHY PLLC
222 S. Main Street, 5th Floor
